methods.ownership: area of the union of a net's copper on the layer (zone fills; and all copper = fills + tracks + pads + via annular rings)
methods.split: boundary of fill A lying within split_gap_max_mm of fill B (length), the min edge-to-edge gap, and tracks on an adjacent copper layer whose centreline crosses the gap between them
methods.void_width: mean width = 2 × area / perimeter (a long thin void along a split reads as its width)
methods.void: outline shrunk by edge_margin_mm, less all copper on the layer; pieces >= min_void_mm2. A piece touching fills of two or more nets is a split gap, otherwise a void. Holes in a fill that contain a drilled hole are antipads and are counted separately
methods.unreferenced_raw: track centreline over no fill on the adjacent copper layer (stackup); fill holes count as no copper
methods.unreferenced_antipads_excl: as raw, but fill holes that contain a drilled hole (via, PTH, NPTH) count as copper
methods.stitching: GND vias (centres) per grid cell; cells at least half inside the outline; nearest GND via to a signal via is centre to centre
